name: Eastern Bluebird
facts: Call pattern: a soft, low warble of a few short phrases, often written "chur-lee, chur-lee."
Habitat: open country with scattered trees, such as pastures, orchards and golf courses. Watches from a low perch and drops onto insects.
Migration: partial. A cavity nester whose numbers rebounded thanks to nest box trails put up by volunteers.
